reviews.text: Great app. After developer response I’ve decided to re-review. I appreciate the response letting me know how to enlarge text size. However it doesn’t quite match with the system settings so when I make the app large enough for me everything else is too large elsewhere. Still they have allowed larger text size so that’s great. Everything else with the app(s) is great. I use other similar apps from the developer but this one is my favorite. I really appreciate having the 12 steps and the 12 traditions in the app. I believe it works offline too because I have a meeting in a park where there is no cell reception and I believe I’ve used these functions offline at that meeting. My new suggestion/ request is to add the promises with the 12&12 & then the app would be top tier. It’s also a fantastic sign that the developer responded to my review because that says to me they plan to keep this app going which is great because I hate paying for apps that get abandoned and get so obsolete they’re no longer available when getting new devices but I have a feeling these guys won’t do that. I also really really appreciate the 1 time fee for access because I wouldn’t subscribe to a monthly even if it was $1 a month because then I’d just go buy the book. My sponsor started sending me passages from this app which is how I found it and I found it so helpful I bought it for myself even though my sponsor said he’d keep sending me the daily readings. I have 4 apps from this developer and plan on getting at least 2 more.

reviews.text:
“My 24 Hour Book”. A desperate woman who couldn’t stop drinking, I woke up in hospital after third suicide attempt thinking, “Oh No! Now what?”. In a very short time,
1 Two AA members showed up and took me to a treatment center, against my will, but I felt powerless to resist.
2. 28 days later I continued the meetings which were part of the recovery program . 
3. My desperation was my surrender. I thought this wouldn’t work for me, but I would try it. First thing every morning on my knees, ask God for a sober day (without questioning what I may or may not believe about Gid) read something spiritual (my sponsor said she read the 24 Hour book) and plan my day around a meeting . At night before going to sleep, say a thank you prayer to God for the 24 hours free of my obsession. 
4. “The 24 Hours a Day” book was perfect to remind me to stay on the right path. It
has had new meaning for me every day. I now read it on my iPhone, but I can still pick up my original “black book” and not only is the message still there for me, I have sticky notes on almost every page. They too help me to rely on the power of God, and stay aware of my own powerlessness. This book has become more precious to me every day. Thanks to all who contributed the daily readings, the ones who were inspired to write each day’s message, the publishers and bookstores who continue to keep it available to us, my sponsor who 
passed it on many 24 hour days ago…
But first and always, I thank God for his grace in everything and everyone who has saved me from desperation and gave me a beautiful life.

reviews.text: The Twenty Four Hour Book. This was the first daily book ever published for a 12th Step recovery program. There are many daily recovery readers now for every possible addiction and / or issue. Find the one that resonates with you and read it first thing in the morning to start your day off with a healthy recovery frame of mind. I have read the 24 Hour A Day book from the earliest days of my recovery 43 years ago. It sets up my day and places me on the right track to live in this 24 hours with a gentle reminder of who and what I am as well as a thoughtful prayer or meditation. No other book resonates with me as the 24 Hour A Day book. Perhaps it is the fact that I have "grown up" with it and it is a great source of comfort, joy and gratitude that I continue to read it daily as I "trudge the Road of Happy Destiny" with all of you.
